blocks.t: You should spend about 20 minutes on Questions 14–26, which are based on Reading Passage 2 on the following pages.
Reading Passage 2 has seven paragraphs, A-G.
Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below.
Write the correct number, i-ix, in boxes 14–20 on your answer sheet.

iiAn undisputed answer to a question about the moai
iiiThe future of the moai statues
